name: Kamishiro Touya
source:
The protagonist of the story. He currently works from home in a condominium he bought in Tokyo.

He has a calm personality, though he does get worked up on rare occasions. Because he spent his childhood in poverty and isolation, he tends to look down on “fun activities” and “people’s kindness” (though deep down, he craves those things). He doesn’t have much experience with women.

Even though he refers to the heroines who’ve signed slave contracts as “fun toys,” he actually cares for them quite a bit. (He’s enjoying their time living together.)

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150903004157/http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/candytoys]official site, archived[/url]]
